description: Use when someone lays out a multiwell plate (ELISA, qPCR, cell or compound assays). Lays out a 6, 12, 24, 48, 96 or 384-well plate: standards, samples, controls and blanks with replicates, filled by row or column, optionally leaving edge wells empty and keeping replicate sets together. Returns a grid with a key and a well-by-well list.

inputSchema.description: Input contract for the Verbex plate map builder: lays out samples, standards, controls and blanks with replicates on 6- to 384-well plates.

avoidEdges.description: Leave the outer wells empty to reduce edge effects.

blanks.description: Number of blank wells, placed last.

controls.description: Control names (e.g. 'NTC', 'Positive control'), placed after samples.

fillDirection.description: Fill across rows (A1, A2, …) or down columns (A1, B1, …).

keepReplicatesTogether.description: Start a new row or column instead of splitting a replicate set.

samples.description: Unique sample names, in placement order.

name: plate_map

card.description: What the Verbex card draws; same values as the notebook entry.

notebookEntry.description: Markdown entry to paste into a lab notebook.

title: Plate map (6- to 384-well)
